findings.claim: GitChangedFiles splits git's output on whitespace via strings.Fields, silently mangling any path containing a space so ruleDelta can miss edits to such rule files and let them slip past the policy check in gated/strict mode.
findings.fix: Split on "\n" and trim, not strings.Fields.

findings.claim: Store.Reload() now runs unconditionally on every Sessions page view (handleSessionsIndex, handleSessionsScope, handleSessionsBatch, handleSessionsArchiveTab), doing a full directory scan and JSON parse of every batch file across every repo on each request with no staleness check.
findings.fix: Confirm the freshness-over-cost tradeoff was deliberate and document it, or add a cheap mtime/dir-listing short-circuit mirroring the registry's stat-identity or the repo cache's fingerprint pattern.

findings.claim: GitRevParse is dead code in production, called only from its own test despite the plan speccing it as part of the git-helpers unit.
findings.fix: Either wire it in where a plain git rev-parse is actually needed or drop it and use shell.Run directly in the test.

findings.claim: GET /sessions/archive shadows the wildcard GET /sessions/{scope} route, permanently hiding a session scope literally named "archive" since validateScopeName and Repo.Validate reserve "archived" and "default" but not "archive".

The sed substitution for __PEEK_HOME_ARGS__ uses | as the delimiter while substituting a value that could itself contain | on an unusual path, and the plist-templating additions expand this pre-existing pattern's surface.
The plan directory does not follow RULE-PLAN-071's <date>-<slug>-<state>-<hash> naming used by every sibling plan dir under v1-2-1/.
